title: Construction Loans Draw Administration Standards
content:
Draws on Construction Loans finance work in place and are approved against inspected progress.

## Standard

A draw may be disbursed only while the loan is in active or extended status. Draws are requested on a draw request with its sequence number and amount; an inspector then certifies the cumulative percent complete. The gross amount approved for a draw is the lower of the amount requested and the cumulative percent complete times the commitment, less gross draws already approved; the product's retainage share of it is withheld as retainage and the rest is disbursed to the payee set by the product's draw payee rule within the product's draw processing time in business days. A draw must be at least the product's minimum draw except the final draw, no more than the product's maximum number of draws may be taken, and where the product requires lien waivers a draw is not funded until lien waivers for the work paid by the previous draw are received. Each draw carries the product's inspection fee and title date-down endorsement fee. Change orders beyond the product's change order tolerance of the budget are referred for re-underwriting, and where the product requires overrun equity first a cost overrun is paid from the member's own funds before any further draw.

## Defined quantities

- **Gross draws already approved:** the total, over every draw on the loan, of the amount disbursed and the retainage withheld.
- **Gross amount approved for a draw:** the lower of (a) the amount requested, and (b) the cumulative percent complete applied to the commitment, less the gross draws already approved.
- **Retainage withheld:** the gross amount approved multiplied by the product's retainage share, rounded to the cent.
- **Amount disbursed:** the gross amount approved less the retainage withheld.
- **Draws taken:** the number of draws disbursed on the loan.

## Effect on balances

The amount disbursed raises the construction principal owed; the retainage withheld raises the retainage held for the builder until completion.

## Status condition

Whether a draw may be disbursed is read from the association's record of the status of that construction loan at the time of the draw: active or extended permits it.

| Loan status on record | Draw may be disbursed |
|---|---|
| active | Yes |
| extended | Yes |
| applied, converting, converted, paid off, declined | No |

## Worked draws (hypothetical inputs)

Commitment USD 500,000; gross draws already approved USD 150,000; inspector's cumulative percent complete 40; illustrative retainage share 10 percent.

- Request of USD 60,000: 40 percent of the commitment is USD 200,000, less USD 150,000 approved leaves USD 50,000; the lower of USD 60,000 and USD 50,000 is USD 50,000. Retainage USD 5,000.00; disbursed USD 45,000.00.
- Request of USD 30,000: the lower of USD 30,000 and USD 50,000 is USD 30,000. Retainage USD 3,000.00; disbursed USD 27,000.00.
